hook: Catherine abruptly stops her lavish wedding to cruelly display what happens to a woman who defies her, leading to the dramatic entrance of a chained Juliana.
cliffhanger: Juliana stands in heavy iron shackles, her bruised face burning with fierce dignity as she faces her tormentors.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily grasp the high-stakes cruelty of a wedding disrupted to humiliate a captive rival, though background on why Juliana is imprisoned is missing.
narrative_context: Catherine stages a public humiliation of Juliana in the middle of her wedding to Rupert before Juliana is even sentenced.
promotional_strength: Provides a striking visual contrast between a lavish wedding and a brutal public shaming, driven by strong antagonistic stakes.

evidence.observation: Catherine abruptly halts her wedding to command silence.
Catherine expresses her sadistic desire to publicly punish a defiant woman.
Juliana is revealed bound in heavy iron shackles.

logline: At the height of Catherine and Rupert's lavish wedding, Juliana is paraded before high society in chains to be publicly disgraced—until a deafening explosion shatters the cathedral entrance, heralding Alexander's vengeful assault.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide symmetrical shot looking down the candlelit, flower-strewn aisle toward the altar where Rupert, Catherine, and the Priest stand.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Catherine abruptly pulls away from Rupert and raises her white-gloved hand high, commanding silence from the congregation.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot tracking Catherine as she pivots toward the seated aristocracy, her veil floating gracefully behind her.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Haughty, Loud)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Before I become Duchess of Ashburgh...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Catherine's face, her lips curling into a sadistic, triumphant sneer.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Resonant)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: ...I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Two-shot profile of Rupert and Catherine. Rupert turns to her with mild caution.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Heavy wooden creak of the cathedral double doors swinging open.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot from behind the altar down the aisle as the great church doors slowly open, revealing the silhouette of three figures against the daylight.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's scarred, dirtied wrists bound tight in heavy iron shackles.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Intense close-up of Juliana's bruised, dirt-streaked face. Her piercing blue eyes burn with fierce dignity despite her captive state.
